title: AI POD composed inventory
description:
Top-level shape for an AI POD inventory that covers one or more subsystems in a single file. Each top-level key is OPTIONAL: a customer deploying only network drops the others; a customer deploying everything provides them all. Inside each subsystem, what is required is required.

Domains (orchestration grouping for Tier 3 playbooks): Network (01–03), Storage (04), Compute (05–06), Platform (07–08), AI Workload (09). The x-aipod-domain annotation on each property is documentation only — not enforced by validation.

Subsystems that are not yet automated reference a placeholder schema that accepts any object today. As each subsystem's automation lands, replace its $ref with the subsystem's real schema and the validation tightens automatically.

Versioning: this schema is /aipod/v1. Breaking changes will publish /aipod/v2 alongside; partners migrate at their own pace. Additive changes (new optional subsystems, new vendors in discriminators) stay within v1.

nd_cluster.description: Subsystem 01 - Nexus Dashboard 4.x cluster install. Fully specified.

backend_fabric_nxos.description: Subsystem 02 - VXLAN EVPN backend (GPU east-west) fabric on NX-OS via NDFC. Stub: any object accepted today.

frontend_fabric_nxos.description: Subsystem 03 - VXLAN EVPN frontend fabric on NX-OS via NDFC. Stub: any object accepted today.

mgmt_fabric_nxos.description: Subsystem 03 - Out-of-band management network fabric on NX-OS onboarded to Nexus Dashboard. Stub: any object accepted today.

storage_everpure.description: Subsystem 04 - Storage on Everpure FlashBlade + XFM aggregation. Stub: any object accepted today. Storage subsystem is vendor-named; future variants land as peer subsystems (storage-netapp, etc.).

mgmt_nodes_ucs.description: Subsystem 05 - UCS management nodes. Supports domain or standalone UCS platforms; OpenShift later assigns control or compact roles.

workload_nodes_ucs.description: Subsystem 06 - UCS workload nodes. Supports general and GPU workloads on domain or standalone UCS platforms; OpenShift later assigns worker or compact roles.

openshift_cluster.description: Subsystem 07 - OpenShift install spanning management and workload nodes; owns control, compact, and worker role assignment plus the operator stack (NVIDIA GPU operator, Network operator, NFD, GPUDirect). Stub: any object accepted today.

mlops.description: Subsystem 08 - MLOps platform (OpenShift AI / Kubeflow / NIM / NeMo). Stub: any object accepted today.

ai_workloads.description: Subsystem 09 - Validation workloads (NCCL allreduce benchmark + small training reference + inference reference). Scope strictly limited to validation workloads; production workloads remain partner/customer concern. Stub: any object accepted today.

site.description: Optional site-wide identity used by logs, asset tags, and observability labels. Lives at the root because it is shared across subsystems.

intersight.description: Optional shared Cisco Intersight SaaS site settings. Consumed by ND claim and later UCS/storage claim. Ansible site inventory stores the same values as intersight_* in group_vars/all.yml. API credentials stay in vault (vault_intersight_api_key_id, vault_intersight_api_private_key). Device ID and Claim Code are runtime-discovered and must not appear here.
